name: Li Ch’ung-yüan
bio: Li Ch’ung-yüan (李重元; Li Chongyuan; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 忆王孙 (Yi wang sun)
poems.author: Li Ch’ung-yüan
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
萋萋芳草忆王孙。
柳外楼高空断魂。
杜宇声声不忍闻。
欲黄昏。
雨打梨花深闭门。
